_comment: Experimental software. No authentication or TLS is implemented. Keep loopback binding or explicitly restrict trusted private access. Independently check every edit; see README.md and docs/USAGE.md.
_expectedOpenFileNameComment: Left empty on purpose: the window locator's Contains() check matches anything against an empty string, so tools act on whatever single NSP window is currently open — including an unsaved new/blank map, which has no filename to match. Set this to a real .nexmap filename only when you need the automation to refuse acting if a second/stale NSP window happens to be open at the same time.
